content.title: LPL Financial (LPLA) Q4 2025 Earnings Transcript
content.summary: Richard Steinmeier: And thank you to everyone for joining our call.  Before touching on our fourth quarter results, it was a milestone year for LPL Financial Holdings Inc. as we significantly advanced our key strategic priorities.  To reflect on a few of our key accomplishments, we delivered industry-leading organic asset growth of 8%, including the onboarding of the retail wealth management businesses of WinTrust Financial and First Horizon, which collectively support over 200 financial advisers managing roughly $34 billion in client assets.
